case_details.title: PHASE 1 ENGINE — Block Document Test Case
case_details.story: A synthetic case file whose entire purpose is to exercise every block type in the Phase 1 universal document engine. Twelve documents covering all sixteen block types across all five themes. Safe to delete; contains no real content.

evidences.title: 07 · Journal — Private Diary
evidences.description: Blocks: prose(handwritten), meta_grid(plain), rule, spacer, signature_row. Theme: notebook.

props.html: Woke before the alarm again. The thing I cannot shake is not the argument but the quiet after it — how fast the room went back to normal, as though nothing had been said at all.
Wrote the names down in order. Cross-checked two of them against the register. The second one is misspelled on the form, which is the only reason I found it.
